scope: LITE-10 数据模型组（15 行，全部指向只有 2 条断言的 M2MigrationRegistryAcceptance.test.ts —— 本轮为其重新指定真实覆盖断言）＋ 两条无点名可运行文件的行
method: 读出候选断言的源码断言体，判断其实际断言的行为是否覆盖条款语义。
被引断言必须在该基线的执行收据中明确出现且为通过（主批次或 covering-batches*.json）。
复合条款缺任一分项的具名断言即记驳回。
本文件只记录判读结论，不改矩阵 tests 指针，不提升任何行状态。

judgments.clause: opaque IDs and Process ID/PID distinction;
judgments.rationale: 不透明 ID —— Identity 套件断言 ID 形如 prefix_ulid 且各类前缀互不混淆；Process ID/PID 区分 —— INSP-04 断言投影同时给出独立 processId 与 nativePidEvidenceOnly。

judgments.clause: Task zero/many Runs and retry child lineage;
judgments.coveringAssertion: TaskRunService atomically rolls back a Run and a newly created Legacy Task when capture fails

supportiveAssertions.name: P3C1-RY-S02 Retry persists the exact fingerprint, Child fields, Events, and Outbox atomically

judgments.rationale: 与 LITE-01-004/02-012 同源证据：零 Run（失败回滚后 listByTask 为 0）与多 Run（同一 Task 下 initial+retry 两条），加上 retry 断言 child.parentRunId===parent.id 的谱系。

judgments.candidateAssertion: MF4I-07 later entry edits do not rewrite the snapshot

partialCoverage.name: MF0-19 snapshot immutability and event payload rules are frozen（mutable=false、rewrittenByLaterEntryEdits=false）

judgments.rationale: 不可变性有两条具名断言（契约冻结 + resolver 的不改写断言）；但「child remapping」（子实体在迁移/复述时的 ID 重映射）在全仓检索（child.*remap / remaps / 重映射断言）无命中。按复合条款口径记驳回。

judgments.coveringAssertion: runtime Events are append-only and preserve Run correlation constraints

supportiveAssertions.name: Task-domain parent deletes are rejected without modifying the append-only Event
INSP-05 events are ordered and bounded（sequence 严格升序）

judgments.rationale: append-only —— DDL 层断言事件行不可改、父实体删除被拒且事件未被修改；per-Run ordering —— INSP-05 断言同一 Run 的投影事件 sequence 恰为 [1,2,3] 升序。

judgments.coveringAssertion: P2C-2B every Event and Outbox position rolls back the composite transaction

supportiveAssertions.name: M3 P6A P01/P02 success claims outside-sink transaction and marks published only after acceptance

judgments.rationale: 原子性 —— 逐位置注入失败并断言整笔复合事务回滚（Event 与 Outbox 同生共死）；重放 —— Outbox 发布器断言只在被接受之后标记 published，重放不重复投递。

judgments.coveringAssertion: P3C1-R27 no-key race: exactly one live 202, one stable 409 RUN_START_ALREADY_ACTIVE, and no idempotency record

supportiveAssertions.name: MF2R-G2 replay converges on the existing Candidate

judgments.rationale: 并发无键竞争收敛为「一个 live、一个稳定 409」（同输入同结果）；带键路径由 RY-C03 断言恰好一条幂等记录；记忆侧重放断言返回既有候选 id。三处均为具名断言。

judgments.coveringAssertion: T48 concurrent transitions produce exactly one winner
judgments.rationale: 与 LITE-11-010 同源：repository 层断言并发迁移恰一个胜者、败者失败；路由层断言并发竞争的 201/409 组合与存活 Run 数为 1。

judgments.coveringAssertion: only the winning created->starting CAS calls spawn; losers join without spawning

supportiveAssertions.name: Process reservation failure rolls back the pair atomically (Session=0, Process=0)

judgments.rationale: 与 LITE-05-001 同一断言：先耗尽 spawn 权的 CAS、胜者才 spawn；预留失败原子回滚为零行，即不会「先 spawn 再补记录」。

judgments.clause: immutable requested/effective mutation classification and `enforcedWorkspaceReadOnly` evidence per Run;
judgments.coveringAssertion: L1D-U03 frozen classifier, not requested class, is effective authority

supportiveAssertions.name: L1D-I17 stale GRANTED READ_ONLY authority cannot reach RunEngine, provider, process, or spawn
L1A-R09 verified with missing boundaryId -> MODIFYING（缺证明字段即为 MODIFYING）

judgments.rationale: 分类不可变 —— L1D-U03 断言生效分类取自冻结分类器而非请求方声明；逐 Run 只读证据 —— L1A-R09..R12 断言缺任一证明字段即降级 MODIFYING；L1D-I17 断言陈旧只读授权无法到达执行侧（零副作用）。

judgments.coveringAssertion: cleanup terminateTree throw fails closed as unknown platform uncertainty

supportiveAssertions.name: cleanup verifySurvivors throw fails closed as unknown platform uncertainty
P6M2b running + mismatch -> no recovery, recovery failure (uncertainty) recorded

judgments.rationale: 两处都断言「证据不可得时失败关闭为 unknown/uncertainty」而不是猜测：清理原语抛错 → unknown platform uncertainty；进程身份 mismatch → uncertainty-marked 且 Run 保持 running。

judgments.coveringAssertion: retained cap fails closed BEFORE any byte commit

supportiveAssertions.name: truncate marks the reference with a bounded reason and source counts continue
segment count derives from the frozen 8 MiB rolling segment cap

judgments.rationale: 有界性 —— 保留上限在任何字节提交**之前**失败关闭；截断 —— 截断以有界原因标记，且源计数继续推进；分段 —— 段数由冻结的 8 MiB 滚动上限推导。三条都是对输出引用有界性的具名断言。

judgments.coveringAssertion: records the tombstone schema through MigrationRunner and keeps it after restart
judgments.rationale: 断言体：通过 MigrationRunner 记录 tombstone 结构并在**重启后仍然保留** —— 即删除留下墓碑且历史不被级联抹除。

judgments.coveringAssertion: [M27-P5-T012] Workspace copy-only scope preserves source bytes and writes no Task-domain records
judgments.rationale: 断言体：兼容模式只做复制、**逐字节保留源数据**且不写 Task 域记录 —— 即兼容读取路径不丢数据、不产生副作用。
judgments.limits: 覆盖 Workspace 兼容复制路径；其他兼容读取面（如 legacy task 读取）由 m2-7 其它套件覆盖，本包未逐条重放。

judgments.coveringAssertion: MF1R-15 record exposes no secret value field

supportiveAssertions.name: MF2R-11 record exposes no secret value field

judgments.rationale: 两条记录形状断言（Entry 与 Candidate）分别断言持久化记录**不暴露秘密值字段**；另有一条断言秘密内容被直接拒绝写入。

judgments.coveringAssertion: P2 Migration Registry contains exactly the registered migrations in contract order
judgments.rationale: 该文件虽只两条断言，但正是本条条款的正面证据：注册表按契约顺序逐项包含 001..031（无替换、无重排），配合各迁移测试中的「001-0xx 保持不变」与各 slice 的「additive only」声明（例如 029/030/031 的迁移注释与各自的 upgrade 对比断言），即增量而非推倒重建。
judgments.limits: 「无 clean-sheet 替换」由注册表顺序 + 各迁移的增量对比断言共同支撑；没有一条单独的「禁止重写历史迁移」断言。
judgments.currentPointer: 同一文件（本条是唯一指针正确的行）

judgments.coveringAssertion: INSP-12 Run, Stage, Provider, Process and duration stay distinct

supportiveAssertions.name: INS-01 the Run overview is distinct from Task/Process and shows duration

judgments.rationale: 两条具名断言分别在后端投影与前端视图两个层面断言 Run/Stage/Provider/Process/Task 的身份互不混淆且可追溯。

judgments.clause: concurrent read-only Runs cannot mutate the Workspace because admission requires tested `enforcedWorkspaceReadOnly` evidence;
judgments.coveringAssertion: L1D-I17 stale GRANTED READ_ONLY authority cannot reach RunEngine, provider, process, or spawn

supportiveAssertions.name: L1D-I18 freshly revalidated GRANTED READ_ONLY authority may pass the dispatcher gate
L1A-R09 verified with missing boundaryId -> MODIFYING

judgments.rationale: 断言体：陈旧的 GRANTED READ_ONLY 授权**无法**到达 RunEngine/Provider/Process/spawn（零副作用）；只有重新校验过的授权才能通过闸门；缺证明字段即降级 MODIFYING。三句合起来覆盖「只读并发准入必须有被验证的 enforcedWorkspaceReadOnly 证据」。
